acceptance: A release UAT shard whose cells all pass reports package exit code 0.
The salt value never appears in logs or uploaded artifacts.
No other workflow that packages UAT results is left without the salt.
context: Evidence: release-v2 run 40971306663 (tag v0.5.0rc2, commit b1459438d), artifact release-uat-v0.5.0rc2-stage1-duckdb: cells.jsonl, uat_gate_summary.json, validator_rollup.tsv, uat_lifecycle.log and per-cell logs. The artifacts do not keep result JSON, so query-level causes need a local rerun of the named cells. The refusal text is in the 'Run the stage 1 shard' step log of job 'UAT stage 1 duckdb'.
description: In release-v2 the UAT package phase exits 1 on every shard, even when every cell passes (DuckDB 57/57, DataFusion and ClickHouse Local 89/89). Each `benchbox submit` call refuses: 'Community publish requires a non-empty public pseudonym salt. Set the BENCHBOX_MACHINE_ID_SALT environment variable' (benchbox/core/results/anonymization.py:205). The shard environment (.github/actions/release-uat-env, .github/workflows/release-v2.yml) never sets the salt. Decide whether release UAT packaging should use a deployment-private salt from a repository secret (owner creates the secret) or a packaging mode that does not need one, then wire it.
